name: anim_fin_wani
subject: a muscular pink paint crocodile monster rising from a paint puddle holding a limp paint-covered small black witch cat by the scruff
desc: The crocodile dangles and shakes the limp dazed cat mockingly, laughing with its head thrown back, the cat swinging and dripping paint, then it flexes its other arm proudly. Thick sticky paint goo stretches and drips.
